title: Welcome to the AI Platform
description: A four-minute tour of the essentials. Skippable anytime.

steps.title: Welcome
steps.body: This is a four-minute walkthrough of the essentials. You can skip anytime with the X button. Ready?
steps.notes: Author-only: keep this warm and short. First impression.

steps.title: Projects live here
steps.body: Every AI workload starts as a **project**. Think of it as a container for your models, data, and workflows.

steps.title: Your workspace
steps.body: This is where the work happens — build, run, and iterate. Everything you do lands here.

steps.title: Create your first project
steps.body: Click here to spin up a new project. You'll see the flow for adding models and data.
steps.notes: Advance-on click so the tour follows the user's own action.

steps.title: Settings and account
steps.body: Your account, workspace settings, and billing all live under your avatar in the corner.

steps.title: You're ready
steps.body: That's the tour. Explore anything from the checklist in the bottom-right whenever you want a walkthrough.
